name: 33523 · Dade City, FL
findings: ZIP 33523 (Dade City) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33523 (Dade City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33523 (Dade City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
